book: Tomus secundus of Daniel Chamier's Panstratia Catholica (Delphinatis, 1627): a Latin controversial treatise, De Deo et Dei cultu, in 22 books (Liber I-XXII), each divided into numbered chapters, preceded by a printed table of contents and followed by indexes of Scripture, authorities and matters.
